text:
Morning kennel crew,
Upbeat round so far, and the training lead noted a detail about travel paperwork

Good morning team,

Please keep attention high on every animal file that reaches the desk today. The passenger coordinator has already flagged a few cases that will need careful review before release to the cabin team, and I need each handoff checked against the current notes before any further movement. Safety remains the first concern on every journey, and we must not allow any rushed step to weaken that standard.

<<FACT F087>> Please make certain that the corresponding record is attached cleanly, legibly, and in the correct order before it leaves the desk. If any supporting page is unclear, incomplete, or inconsistent with the intake summary, return it at once for correction rather than forwarding it. The cabin team relies on us to send only complete files, and the travelers expect a calm, professional process from start to finish.

Continue to monitor every animal with patient care and steady communication, especially where there is handover pressure at the counter. Use the usual checklists, confirm that all travel notes are readable, and escalate any concern without delay. If you see a mismatch between the booking notes and the animal welfare instructions, pause the process and bring it forward immediately. This is urgent, and the desk must remain fully aligned so that no animal, traveler, or crew member is placed at risk by avoidable paperwork errors.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
